subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What does “la pescadería” mean?
questions.explain: “La pescadería” (from “pescado”, fish) means “the fishmonger's”.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I live in a flat in the city centre”?
options: Vivo en un piso en las afueras
Vives en un piso en el centro de la ciudad
Vivo en un piso en el centro de la ciudad
Vivo en una casa en el campo
questions.explain: “Un piso” = a flat and “el centro de la ciudad” = the city centre.

questions.q: What does “la librería” mean?
questions.explain: “La librería” is a false friend: it means “bookshop”, while “library” is “la biblioteca”.

questions.q: Which means 'I will travel to Spain next year' (future)?
options: Viajé a España el año pasado
Viajaré a España el año que viene
questions.explain: 'Viajaré' is the future tense 'I will travel'; with 'el año que viene' (next year) the future is correct.

questions.q: What does “la planta baja” mean?
questions.explain: “La planta baja” means “the ground floor”.

questions.q: How do you say “We must recycle more”?
questions.explain: “Hay que” = one must and “reciclar más” = recycle more.

questions.q: What does “el equipaje de mano” mean?
questions.explain: “El equipaje” = luggage and “de mano” = hand, so “el equipaje de mano” = “hand luggage”.

questions.q: What does “sigue todo recto” mean when giving directions?
questions.explain: “Seguir todo recto” means “to go straight on”.

questions.q: What does “el reciclaje” mean?
questions.explain: “El reciclaje” means “recycling”.

questions.q: How do you say “It's snowing in the mountains”?
questions.explain: “Nevar” = to snow, so “está nevando” = it's snowing.

questions.q: What does “la carnicería” mean?
questions.explain: “La carnicería” (from “carne”, meat) means “the butcher's shop”.

questions.q: What does “la contaminación” mean?
questions.explain: “La contaminación” means “pollution”.

questions.q: Which sentence means “My house is opposite the church”?
options: Mi casa está al lado de la iglesia
Mi casa está enfrente de la iglesia
Mi casa está detrás de la iglesia
Mi casa es enfrente de la iglesia
questions.explain: “Enfrente de” = “opposite” and location uses “estar”, so “Mi casa está enfrente de la iglesia”.

questions.q: How do you say “I live on the third floor”?
options: Vivo en la tercera planta baja
questions.explain: “Tercer” shortens before a masculine noun, so “el tercer piso” = “the third floor”.

questions.q: What does “los gases de efecto invernadero” mean?
questions.explain: “El efecto invernadero” = the greenhouse effect, so these are “greenhouse gases”.

questions.q: How do you say “We must protect the planet”?
questions.explain: “Proteger” = to protect and “el planeta” is masculine: “Hay que proteger el planeta”.

questions.q: Which means “I'd recommend visiting the old town”?
questions.explain: “El casco antiguo” means “the old town”, and “recomendaría” is the conditional “I'd recommend”.

questions.q: What does “una zona peatonal” mean?
questions.explain: “Peatonal” relates to “peatón” (pedestrian), so “una zona peatonal” = “a pedestrian area”.

questions.q: What does “doblar a la derecha” mean?
questions.explain: “Doblar a la derecha” means “to turn right”.

questions.q: What does “el medio ambiente” mean?
questions.explain: “El medio ambiente” means “the environment”.

questions.q: How do you say “The journey lasts two hours”?
questions.explain: “Durar” = to last, so “el viaje dura dos horas” = the journey lasts two hours.

questions.q: Which sentence means “Many species are in danger of extinction”?
options: Pocas especies están en peligro de extinción
Muchas especies son en peligro de extinción
Muchas especies están en peligro de extinción
Muchas especias están en peligro de extinción
questions.explain: “Las especies” = species (not “especias” = spices) and “en peligro de extinción” = in danger of extinction.
